questions.title: Chronic UV exposure is the most important risk factor for this fair-skinned man's skin cancer
questions.question: A 42 years old fair skin man has a skin nodule on the right hand. It becomes larger and dark in color. The lesion was excised and proved to be skin cancer. Which of the following risk factor is most important for development of this tumor?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Inherited Rb gene mutation predisposes to retinoblastoma and certain sarcomas, not the sporadic skin cancer this fair-skinned patient's sun-exposed hand lesion suggests.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Asbestos exposure is linked to mesothelioma and lung cancer, not skin cancer.
explanations.C: Correct. Chronic exposure to ultraviolet (UV) rays is the most important risk factor for skin cancer, especially in fair-skinned individuals whose lower melanin content gives less natural photoprotection. A darkening, enlarging pigmented nodule on a sun-exposed area such as the hand in a fair-skinned man is a classic presentation pointing to UV-driven skin malignancy, distinct from the risk factors named for the other options.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Cigarette smoking is a major risk factor for lung, bladder and several other cancers, but it is not the most important risk factor for this fair-skinned patient's sun-exposed skin lesion.

questions.title: Corticosteroids are not a chemical carcinogen
questions.question: Chemical carcinogens include all EXCEPT:

explanations.A: Incorrect (as the EXCEPT) -- azo compounds are genuine chemical carcinogens.
explanations.B: Incorrect (as the EXCEPT) -- polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons are genuine chemical carcinogens, classically linked to lung cancer from cigarette smoke.
explanations.C: Incorrect (as the EXCEPT) -- asbestos is a genuine chemical/physical carcinogen, classically linked to mesothelioma and lung cancer.
explanations.D: Correct (as the EXCEPT). Corticosteroids are not classed among the chemical carcinogens; they are anti-inflammatory/immunosuppressive hormonal agents. Azo compounds, polycyclic hydrocarbons and asbestos, by contrast, are all named chemical carcinogens in the department's own teaching list, making corticosteroids the one substance here that does not belong.

questions.title: H pylori infection is involved in the development of gastric lymphoma
questions.question: H pylori infection is involved in development of:

explanations.A: Correct. Chronic Helicobacter pylori infection is implicated in the development of gastric lymphoma, particularly MALT (mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue) lymphoma, through sustained antigenic stimulation of gastric lymphoid tissue, as well as gastric adenocarcinoma via chronic gastritis. This is a distinctive bacterial-carcinogenesis association, unlike brain tumours, metastasis in general or colon carcinoma, none of which H. pylori is characteristically linked to.
explanations.B: Incorrect. H. pylori infection is not characteristically linked to brain tumour development.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Metastasis is a general process of tumour spread, not a specific disease H. pylori is implicated in causing.
explanations.D: Incorrect. H. pylori's carcinogenic association is with the stomach, not colon carcinoma specifically.

questions.title: Human papilloma virus is associated with cervical cancer
questions.question: Human papilloma virus is associated with:

explanations.A: Incorrect. Endometrial cancer is not the characteristic HPV-associated malignancy; it is more associated with unopposed oestrogen exposure.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Colorectal cancer is not the characteristic HPV-associated malignancy.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Breast cancer is not a virus-associated malignancy in standard teaching.
explanations.D: Correct. Human papilloma virus (HPV), particularly high-risk strains such as HPV-16 and HPV-18, is strongly associated with cervical cancer, through viral oncoprotein inactivation of tumour suppressor gene products. This is one of the best-established virus-cancer associations in oncology, distinguishing HPV's specific link to cervical cancer from endometrial, colorectal or breast cancer, none of which it characteristically causes.

questions.title: Breast cancer is not related to virus infection
questions.question: The following cancer is NOT related to virus Infection:

explanations.A: Incorrect (as the NOT-related option) -- Burkitt's lymphoma is a genuine EBV-associated malignancy.
explanations.B: Incorrect (as the NOT-related option) -- nasopharyngeal cancer is a genuine EBV-associated malignancy.
explanations.C: Incorrect (as the NOT-related option) -- cervical cancer is a genuine HPV-associated malignancy.
explanations.D: Correct. Breast cancer is not classed as a virus-related malignancy in standard teaching, unlike Burkitt's lymphoma and nasopharyngeal cancer (both EBV-associated) or cervical cancer (HPV-associated). This makes breast cancer the one cancer among the options without an established viral carcinogenesis link.

questions.title: Hepatitis C virus is the most important carcinogenic virus in Egypt
questions.question: The most important carcinogenic virus in Egypt is:

explanations.A: Correct. Hepatitis C virus (HCV) is taught as the most important carcinogenic virus in Egypt, reflecting the country's historically very high HCV prevalence and its strong association with chronic liver disease progressing to hepatocellular carcinoma. This local-epidemiology teaching point distinguishes HCV's importance in Egypt specifically from HPV, HIV or EBV, each carcinogenic in its own right but not the department's named most important carcinogenic virus for this population.
explanations.B: Incorrect. Human papilloma virus is an important carcinogenic virus generally (cervical cancer), but the printed key names hepatitis C virus specifically as most important in Egypt.
explanations.C: Incorrect. HIV itself is not directly oncogenic in the way the printed key describes, though it predisposes to certain cancers through immunosuppression; it is not the answer this Egypt-specific question asks for.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Epstein-Barr virus is an important carcinogenic virus generally, but the printed key names hepatitis C virus specifically as most important in Egypt.
